rules: A price/range/return leg multiplied by TS_RANK($dollar_volume, W) fails cheap_screen even though the same pair can pass as a TS_CORR: CS_RANK($high-$low)*TS_RANK($dollar_volume,63) scored t=0.43 and TS_SUM($return,40)*TS_RANK($dollar_volume,63) scored t=0.85, while CS_RANK(fundamental)*TS_RANK(volume/price stat) again cleared everything (fitness 1.864). Reserve the multiply-combinator for a fundamental leg; use TS_CORR for price/range-vs-volume pairs.

CS_RANK(($high-$low)/(TS_MAX($high,21)+eps)) and its TS_MEAN($dollar_volume or $open, W) sibling are a saturated chassis: 3 of this round's rejects swapped only the numerator or the denominator's field/window and still shared 5-10 nodes with an archive member. Stop generating new candidates on this exact ratio shape.

Two-leg RANK(A) op RANK(B) proposals still collide on archive_subtree when only one leg changes and the other is left byte-identical to an archived leg (RANK($roa)-RANK(TS_SUM($return,63)); RANK(TS_DELTA($operating_margin,63))*RANK($asset_turnover)). Mutate both legs together, not just one.

Bare TS_RANK of a raw fundamental level fails at any window, for different gates: TS_RANK($roa,63) missed cheap_screen (t=0.86), TS_RANK($roe,252) missed coverage (0.871). Apply TS_DELTA to a fundamental before ranking or smoothing it, as the accepted TS_STD(TS_DELTA(field,1),W) pair did.

A single-fundamental TS_STD-normalized momentum spread narrowly missed cheap_screen (t=0.89) while a CS_ZSCORE of a spread between two different fundamentals at matched windows scored 3.081 — worth retesting, since cross-field, CS_ZSCORE, and matched windows all changed at once so the cause isn't isolated yet.

Swapping the OHLC field used as a ratio's denominator doesn't decorrelate a fundamental-ratio factor: $eps/$open vs $eps/$close hit rho 0.825. Treat OHLC fields as collinear, the same way the already-flagged smoothing-operator and volume-normalizer swaps are.

A smoothed price_t/price_(t-1) ratio fails cheap_screen the same way $return-driven kernels do (TS_MEAN($open/DELAY($open,1),10) scored t=0.32) — screen out manually reconstructed 'synthetic returns' too, not just proposals that reference $return directly.

This round's fundamental accepts all wrapped roe/roa/accrual_gap in a delta or a between-field spread rather than ranking a level directly; keep building on that shape rather than plain fundamental-level transforms.
